hero.headline: Your team and its agents, in the same space
hero.sub: Create a shared workspace where people and agents collaborate with the same knowledge, connections, workflows and access rules. Everything stays under your organisation's control.
hero.install_label: Or install it on your server:

how.title: From zero to your first agent in three steps
how.install_body: One command on your server. Pick Docker or a direct build from GitHub; the installer handles the rest.
how.connect_body: Add the API keys of the providers you already use. They stay in your instance and never travel anywhere.
how.build_body: Give them knowledge, memory and skills, share them with your team and export them to the tools you already work in.

overview.title: Move from isolated agents to a coordinated work group
overview.body: Bring agents, people, models, knowledge, tools and workflows into a workspace with traceable ownership, permissions and usage.

features.multi_agent_body: Create as many specialised agents as you need, each with its own knowledge, its connections and its memory. No artificial limits.
features.providers_body: Connect Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok and Ollama with your own API keys. Switch providers without touching a line of your agents.
features.groups_body: Each group is an operational workspace: it brings together members, agents, connections, LLM orchestrations, workflows, knowledge, prompts, skills and tools without duplicating them.
features.selfhosted_body: Your data never leaves your server. Deploy on your own infrastructure with a single command, with no external dependencies.
features.knowledge_body: Turn documents, URLs and notes into real context for your agents, with no model retraining and no cloud dependency.
features.skills_body: Give your agents reusable tools: build a skill once and share it across every single agent that needs it.
features.dashboard_body: Monitor token and resource usage, and track the evolution of everything your team builds, in real time and per agent.
features.centinel_body: An admin panel with a built-in test suite: verify your instance's health with one click before every deployment.
features.export_body: Export your agents to the native format of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or OpenAI Assistants. Build once, use them wherever you work.

groups.title: A work group is far more than a shared folder
groups.body: It is a team's operating context. Resources keep their owner, members receive only the access they need, and everything can be used without copying settings or credentials.
groups.ownership: Clear ownership and permissions for every resource.
groups.cascade: Agents and workflows cascade-share the dependencies they need.
groups.credentials: Connections remain private even when a group can use them.

panel.note: Rubén can use María's connection without seeing or exporting her API key.

install.title: Install and update
install.hint: The same command installs and updates. On first install you can choose the deployment mode.
install.docker_body: pulls from GitHub Container Registry and enables automatic updates.
install.local_body: builds from GitHub and retains every feature.
install.components: In either mode you can install the full application, the backend only, or the frontend only.

close.title: Set up your first work group this afternoon
close.body: A free account on the managed hub, or one command if you would rather run your own server.
